## Checklist

- [ ] The title starts with the chapter (`[Ch N]`) and gives nothing away
- [ ] Everything new is tagged with the chapter that reveals it; where unsure, I used the later chapter
- [ ] Notes are written as of their chapter, with no hindsight
- [ ] New names, nicknames or later names are covered by `revealAt` / `secret`, or an embargo
- [ ] All text is my own paraphrase; no book text is pasted
- [ ] No cover art, fan art or other copyrighted images
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (spoiler lint, type-check, build)
- [ ] `npm run test:spoilers` passes against `npm run preview` (or I'm relying on CI)
